correctness.rationale: The distance-vector proof was reconstructed in all singleton, multipartite, and bipartite cases; every lower bound has an explicit indistinguishable pair and every upper bound has an explicit landmark construction. Exact exhaustive enumeration agrees for all 58 multipartite types of orders 2 through 8.

originality.rationale: The claim is limited to an explicit correction and synthesis. Prior edge and complete-bipartite formulas are credited. Targeted comparison against the 2017, 2018, 2022, and 2023 primary literature and semantic-result records found no matching published all-parameter correction.

value.rationale: The result corrects two exact complete-multipartite statements in a published 2022 paper, supplies concrete counterexamples, and gives a compact replacement formula with a self-contained proof.
